svg.title: Institutional Data Voids: Twelve Confirmed Absent Datasets (GA-001 to GA-012)
svg.desc: Schematic diagram grouping twelve critical government datasets absent from public record across three categories: rates and compliance, legal protections, and forensic tracking.
svg.text: ACCOUNTABILITY VOIDS AUDIT · TWELVE UNPUBLISHED DATASETS
Twelve Datasets Confirmed Absent From Official Records (GA-001 – GA-012)

g.text: GROUP 1 · RATES, FILINGS & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE (GA-001 TO GA-005)
Annual conviction rates by district/tribunal · FIR registration logs · 90-day statutory compliance rate · Case abandonment tracking.
GROUP 2 · STATUTORY PROTECTION & LEGAL REFORM (GA-006 TO GA-008)
False-allegation (§17) prosecution metrics · Witness Protection Act enactment status (pending since 2015) · Marital rape legal exception status.
GROUP 3 · FORENSIC & MEDICAL TRACKING (GA-009 TO GA-012)
District-level DNA backlog breakdown · Hospital medical examination denial logs (§32 tracking) · Comprehensive forensic pipeline tracing.

svg.text: Audit standard: Each absence represents a specific information gap where public data is withheld, fragmented, or unmonitored.
